{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# The contract specifies: population = all orders in the dataset
# So we must use ALL orders, including refunded ones, for the denominator
# But conversion is only defined for completed checkouts
# So: converted = 1 only if status == 'completed'
# And the denominator for conversion rate is total number of orders in the channel

# Compute conversion rate by channel: (completed checkouts) / (total orders)
channel_counts = df_clean.groupby('channel').size()  # total orders per channel
channel_converted = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()  # completed checkouts

# Conversion rate = completed / total orders
conversion_rate = channel_converted / channel_counts

# Extract rates
email_rate = conversion_rate['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rate['paid_search']

difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print all values explicitly
print("total_orders_email:", channel_counts['email'])
print("completed_email:", channel_converted['email'])
print("conversion_rate_email:", email_rate)

print("total_orders_paid_search:", channel_counts['paid_search'])
print("completed_paid_search:", channel_converted['paid_search'])
print("conversion_rate_paid_search:", paid_search_rate)

print("difference:", difference)

# Round for reporting
rounded_difference = round(difference, 4)
print("rounded_difference:", rounded_difference)"}
